324:0.en: 「$$桂$$...\nI'll give it my all to the very end!」

324:203.en: 「I've got a five-year career\nlead on you, you know?」

alternatives: I'll take you down for sure!

324:890.en: 「Stop or I shoot!\nI shoot either way!」

324:1055.en: 「Damn! What did I do to deserve\nfighting my daughter?!」

324:1116.en: 「I'll shoot you down, mech and all!」

324:1808.en: 「What a pain! Let's end this now!」

324:2110.en: 「Then you and I can... have some fun!」

324:2272.en: 「Think you can keep up, $$オルソン$$?」

324:2718.en: 「I won't keep letting you beat me!」

324:2794.en: 「Even a nice guy like me gets mad!」

324:2819.en: 「You'll regret laying a hand on me!」

324:2916.en: 「No game of love?\nThen count me out!」

324:3148.en: 「I can't just stand by and watch!」

324:3181.en: 「A man's duty is to protect girls!」

324:3218.en: 「I won't let you hurt my honey!」

alternatives: Pardon me, I'm going on ahead!

324:3431.en: 「I can't do it with this weapon...!」

324:3462.en: 「You really are quick to run away.」

324:3716.en: 「Come on, isn't it time you gave up?」

324:3861.en: 「Keep this up and girls'll hate you.」

324:3904.en: 「Only girls get to fight over me!」

324:3947.en: 「I'd rather get a kiss\nthan a slap.」

324:4156.en: 「I can't afford to lose in the air!」

324:4548.en: 「You can barely keep up with me.」

324:4612.en: 「I hate being chased by a man.」

324:5035.en: 「Gah! Damn it, now you've done it!」

324:5314.en: 「Ugh, I hate this. Men, I swear...」

324:5461.en: 「Y-You really went all out on me...!」

324:5631.en: 「This is absurd! Please be a dream!」

324:5758.en: 「Guh! One more hit\nand we fall apart!」

324:5852.en: 「Go for broke!\nI thrive in a pinch!」

324:5915.en: 「Guh! But\nI always shine in a crisis!」

324:6325.en: 「$$オルソン$$, Earth's lovely, rift or not.」

324:6494.en: 「I'll come back!\nWait for me, $$ミムジィ$$!」

324:6645.en: 「This world and us alike...\nwe don't belong to you!」

324:7120.en: 「Even a monster like that is here...!」

324:7182.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

324:7986.en: 「This is no time to be impressed!」

324:8237.en: 「Get us out of here, quickly! Now!」

324:8406.en: 「$$桂$$, I can't keep up with repairs!」

324:8745.en: 「I'll try hard with $$桂$$ and you. Bye!」

324:8921.en: 「Guess I've got no time to play...!」

324:9010.en: 「$$オーガス$$ is the name of a war god!\nDid you know?」

324:9106.en: 「No matter who it is, I gotta do it!」

324:9178.en: 「Time to show what I can do!」

324:9236.en: 「Whatever it takes,\nI'm going back to $$ミムジィ$$!」

324:9400.en: 「I'm counting on you to aim, $$モーム$$!」

324:9495.en: 「Guess I gotta slug 'em a few times!」

324:9900.en: 「I don't mind a girl who\nwon't be honest, either...!」

324:9951.en: 「A system running solo? What a joke!」

324:9994.en: 「Some robots are good, some bad,\nand you're the latter!」

324:10094.en: 「Looking backward is no way\nto go repairing spacetime!」

324:10184.en: 「Whatever the reason,\nnobody has the right to do this!」

324:10237.en: 「Some twist of fate made us enemies!」

324:10307.en: 「Bear with me a little!\nI'll save you right away!」

324:10397.en: 「I don't have time to deal with you!」

324:10434.en: 「"No more war!"\nGuess now's not the time for that!」

324:10485.en: 「I get how you feel, but\nthere's a right way to do it!」

324:10579.en: 「I'll hit on you in a few years...!」

324:10622.en: 「Well then, time to ask for a date!」

324:10663.en: 「Let me show you how cool I am!」

324:10702.en: 「Sorry, but I've got no other choice!」

324:10739.en: 「I'd like us to understand\neach other too, if we can!」

324:10792.en: 「Though the foes number thousands,\njustice always wins, as they say!」

324:10872.en: 「$$宇宙怪獣$$? I go all out!」

324:10954.en: 「Darkness, despair... that stuff\njust isn't my thing!」

324:11009.en: 「I'm not about to listen\nto some evil god!」

324:11093.en: 「Anyone who settles things by force\ngets this!」

324:11142.en: 「Time for the $$サイデリアル$$ to exit!」

324:11183.en: 「Thanks for coming out to the sticks!」

324:11259.en: 「You're a nuisance to the world!\nYour very existence!」

324:11390.en: 「Swayed by power we don't deserve...\nwe're in the same boat!」

324:11445.en: 「Ugh, I can't stand it...\nhating and being hated!」

324:11535.en: 「I'll rip the mask off\nthat bluffing commander!」

324:11584.en: 「Mmm!\nYou're way better out of that armor!」

324:11633.en: 「I'll crush the head, end the Empire!」

324:11676.en: 「$$次元将$$ meets $$スフィア$$...!\nNow that's a worthy foe!」

324:11739.en: 「People who call themselves great\nare never any good!」

324:11794.en: 「If this is an emissary of God,\nI don't even feel like praying!」

324:11851.en: 「You're a god, yet what you do\nis so petty!」

324:11900.en: 「What would a stiff-necked judge\nknow about us?!」

324:11953.en: 「Even when you're just playing,\nsome things are off limits!」

324:12010.en: 「I'll be blunt!\nThat smile of yours is shady!」

324:12071.en: 「We didn't fight all this time\njust to please you!」

324:12128.en: 「You sure look down on us, big shot!」

324:12165.en: 「If you think you're special humans,\nyou're dead wrong!」

324:12251.en: 「$$アサキム$$!\nTime we laid you to rest for good!」

324:12310.en: 「It's over, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nAnd now we start our future!」

324:12373.en: 「$$ミムジィ$$... I'll do it!\nFor you, the baby, and everyone!」

324:12434.en: 「Me too, of course! Let's go, $$モーム$$!」

324:12636.en: 「Then I'll leave the rest to you!」

324:12661.en: 「Me and $$オルソン$$ make an unbeatable duo!」

324:12832.en: 「That's what you get for not running!」

324:12867.en: 「Turns out I can catch up to you!」

324:12902.en: 「Leave the ones you missed to me!」

324:12933.en: 「Time to rack up my kill count!」

324:13118.en: 「Why the rush?! That's not like you!」

324:13442.en: 「Let's take the lead and stay ahead!」

324:13809.en: 「Gotta use my head once in a while!」

324:13879.en: 「Can't take a hit like that head-on.」

324:13998.en: 「Can't argue with that! Ha ha ha!」

324:14305.en: 「Oh boy, that was a sorry sight...」

324:14510.en: 「When it rains, it pours!\nThe more I try, the worse it gets!」

324:14694.en: 「You've got some nerve, $$サイデリアル$$...!」

324:14766.en: 「I'd gladly lose to you...\nbut no time for that!」

324:14905.en: 「Iron heart with stainless\nsteel hair on it...!」

324:15097.en: 「Damn! I won't go down that easily!」

324:15480.en: 「But I'm the one being worked hard.」

324:15523.en: 「Spare me. The girls would be sad.」
